car.name: Houndstongue 1982
car.description: Jacky Ickx / Derek Bell, 1982 Le Mans-winning Porsche 956 #1 Group C inspiration. Early 935/76 twin-turbo flat-six, mechanical injection, rear drive and five-speed manual. Original oxblood/cream art; simulation setup estimates labeled.

catalogProvenance.referenceVehicle: Jacky Ickx / Derek Bell, 1982 Le Mans overall-winning Porsche 956 #1 Group C long-tail. Not 956B, 962, 917 or road conversion.

sources.access: Porsche Group C engineering history: early935/76 Kugelfischer mechanical injection; water-cooled heads/air-cooled cylinders; five speeds. Bosch Motronic MS2 arrives later1982, after Le Mans. 800kg minimum/100L maximum are regulations, not race-day loading.
1982 museum test-mule reference:2649cc,456kW (620HP),360km/h. Not the winning #1 chassis or exact event dyno.

estimates: 456kW converts to611.506 mechanical hp; Porsche museum620HP is approximately metric PS, not620mechanical hp. Museum test-mule output and360km/h are reference context, not authenticated #1 race-day figures. No chassis serial claimed.

850kg running mass,450lb-ft peak torque, intermediate curve, RPM limits, ratios/final drive,220mph/3.4s0–60 targets, dimensions/tracks, suspension, brakes and aero are simulation estimates. 800kg regulatory minimum does not establish running mass.100L tank uses period maximum, not verified event fuel load. Equal300/45R16 tires approximate period slicks, not verified stagger.

Native generic turbo/piston model and sound do not reproduce twin-turbo control, injection/cooling details, or underbody ground-effect tunnels. No shared code changed. Five gears are sourced; Auto Assist is accessibility only. Digital live instruments and shared steering/wiper graphics are gameplay conventions.

Original oxblood/cream/cyan art with no copied Rothmans livery, logos or numbers. Body topology is early short-wheelbase long-tail inspiration, not measured aerodynamic reconstruction. Native decoded tire opacity normalization preserves PNG originals.
